name: Natural
summary: Agentic payments platform: FDIC-insured wallets agents can hold and send from, plus ACH, wire and real-time payments, over API, MCP, CLI and SDKs.
description: Natural Direct went GA on 2026-10-29, letting an agent choose ACH, wire or real-time (RTP/FedNow) payouts from the same wallet it uses for instant payments, payment requests and cards, within the controls you set. Surfaces: hosted payments MCP at https://mcp.natural.com (OAuth-first, agent API keys as fallback), a no-auth docs MCP at https://docs.natural.com/mcp, REST at api.natural.com, the `natural` CLI, and SDKs (`naturalpay` for Python, `@naturalpay/sdk` for TypeScript, both 1.6.54). Signup and KYB need a human. Accounts are free; payments carry fees (e.g. Pay 0.1% for businesses, ACH 0.5%, wire 0.25%, real-time 1.5%). Operated by Natural AI, Inc.

agent_access.notes: Payments MCP: OAuth (or agent API key as Bearer). Docs MCP https://docs.natural.com/mcp needs no auth. REST/SDK amounts use integer minor units; MCP amounts use decimal strings plus currency.
